units.source_text: 轮到的随从，就得穿着世袭的素绸服，脚蹬武士草鞋，

en.t: The attendant whose turn it was had to wear the hereditary plain silk robe and put on warrior straw sandals,

units.source_text: 系上揽袖带，头缠五条袈裟的僧侣冠，腰间插着两把刀，掖着南天竹叶子。

en.t: tie on a sleeve cord, wrap his head in a monk's cap made from a five-panel priestly stole, carry two swords at his waist, and tuck nandina leaves under his arm.

units.source_text: 伐竹用的樵刀则放在锦囊里。

en.t: The woodcutter's knife used for cutting bamboo was kept in a brocade pouch.

units.source_text: 在开路人的引领下，向山门进发。

en.t: Led by the path opener, they set out toward the temple gate.
